lines.name: Market Line
lines.beyond: both ends leave the sheet: south on Sunset Way past y -780, north on Harbour Road past y 320; termini and depot off-sheet

notes: I added tram T2 (Market Line) and left T1 and S1 as they were. I checked it by hand only. I have not run the plan checker, so I can't show exit 0 yet. Rerun bun tools/plan/cli.ts before this is accepted.

T2 is one double-track running path. It enters at the south sheet edge on Sunset Way (x -346) and turns east with an R50 bend at (-346,-410). It runs along Market Street's 6 m median (z -410, tracks at ±1.8). At (306,-410) it turns north with an R50 bend onto Harbour Road and leaves the sheet at y 320. Both ends reach the sheet edge, so it needs no terminal loops (T-L1) and has no dead ends (N-D1).

T-C1 by hand: the tracks on Sunset Way (x -346) and Harbour Road (x 306) sit 6 m off centre, beside the 4 m medians. That keeps each R50 bend inside the carriageway. At the bend midpoints, x is about -331 (Sunset Way spans -352 to -328) and about 291 (Harbour Road spans 288 to 312). The inner tracks are about 1.3 m further in and stay inside too. A bend on the road centreline would cut about 3 m into the corner plots.

Reach, straight-line distance to the stop sites I'm suggesting: Lantern West (-260,-563) is about 86 m from Sunset Way at z -560. Rocket West (-260,-296) is about 118 m from Market Street at x -230. Docks East (262,-512) is about 107 m from Market Street at x 230. Harbour East (262,-267) is about 44 m from Harbour Road at z -267. All four are under 250 m, with margin left for detours.

Interchanges (N-C1): T1's Records stop (0,-380) is about 50 m from a T2 stop near (±40,-410). S1's Harbour station (340,0) is about 45 m from a T2 stop near (306,-30). All three lines now connect within 150 m.

T2 crosses T1 at grade at (0,-410), the Boulevard and Market Street junction. The standards have no rule on this. On Harbour Road it runs under S1 at y 0, clear of the median where S1's pylons stand. T2 is on the primary ring, on Sunset Way and Harbour Road. This partly brings back tide's T2 Harbour Line, which runs north from Market Street. The south end of Harbour Road still can't take a terminus. I'm still rejecting the Sky Loop for the corner-plot S-C1 reasons I gave last round.

The off-sheet continuations are my assumption. The sources don't say where T2 goes beyond the sheet. Aster should confirm with Sky, along with the open questions from last round: whether T1 ends at the circus, and whether the Sphere and harbour loops are retired. The conflict in the circus geometry is still there: the drawn road shape and the island ring don't match. I will fix that when I next edit the roads.
